                 u′(1/2) = 18·(1/2) − 9 = 9 − 9 = 0
    Canonical form: every dA_k/dt|_{1/2} carries the common factor u′(1/2) = 0
    Direction:   all three first derivatives vanish EXACTLY at t = 1/2; second derivative
                 d²A₆/dt²|_{1/2} = c₆·u″ = 18·c₆ ⇒ documented sign = sign(c₆f₃) (min-vs-max
                 character REPORTED, not gated; workshop (ii) L2)
    Conclusion:  the Sage certificate targets exact symbolic zeros — analytically guaranteed
                 by u′(1/2) = 0; any non-zero is a machinery error, not a physics finding.

    CHAIN B (column-3 trigger — the claim "expected SILENT; fires iff S(σ*) ≤ S(0), |σ*| ≥ 1e-4"):
    Definition 1: S(σ;τ) = spectral action on the σ-dial torsion family at the published

## §W1-4. S101-VIIAM-ALPHA-ENVELOPE-PIN

§VII.AM Level-2 envelope α-pin (`session-100a-w6-workingpaper.md` CF-W6-1, lines 200–207 — BINDING). The registry's own named route (line 16747): "S89+ carry-forward will pin α via L_max-scan on the Bogoliubov-spectrum-reorganization-rate observable." The named resolution event (`S89-UNIVERSAL-LOCK-CONDITION-STAGE-2-CROSS-AXIS-VERIFY` = `S100a-VIIAM-STAGE2-VERIFY`, audit `6dc0f374ffd3ee4e`) is RESOLVED-as-EXECUTED WITHOUT delivering the α pin; this gate delivers it. Refinement compute, NOT a Stage-2 verify — **no Stage-2 exclusion applies** (the CF block says so explicitly; volovik's Stage-2 reviewer role on §VII.AM does not exclude it here).
